title: The Wednesday before
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Wednesday. The tech runs Thanksgiving's digest early. The lot half empty. The guard gone home. Wood and the tech and the machine and the dog. The tech says happy Thanksgiving. Wood says corn. The tech says what. Wood says nothing; it's a strip thing.

panels.composition: The print shop, the hall empty, the TECH running the digest. WOOD. BARNABY.

image.prompt: a print technician running copies in a quiet print shop while a young man and a small dog wait, the hall outside empty, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The copies. Warm. The last before the holiday.

image.prompt: close on warm photocopies in a tray, black and white, no words
a print technician, plain, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The empty hall. The two of them and the dog in the lit door. The tech's tally on the wall: fifty-nine. The gap in March. The strip has a Thanksgiving and it's a print shop.

image.prompt: an empty college hallway with a lit print shop doorway holding two men and a small dog, black and white, no words

notes: 'Strip thing.' Fifty-nine on the tech's wall.
